feedback.question: Does closed-loop model/optimizer state amplify an otherwise diffusive local update?

source_transport.question: Does a local implementation residual survive as a non-canceling effective update?

interpretation.diffusive_or_canceling: actual component remains within the frozen matched-null regime
interpretation.feedback_sustained: local component is null-like while feedback and actual components are coherent
interpretation.source_persistent: source/orbit or transported local component has excess coherence
interpretation.unresolved: measurement power, recurrence, or semantic-orbit validity is insufficient

objective: Test whether low-cost source/orbit/transport and feedback probes predict implementation-induced effective-update persistence.
predictor_freeze_gate: all development cases use the same 16-state horizon
each reported statistic has an empirical matched null
at least one semantics-preserving intervention changes the proposed predictor
predictor implementation cannot read case IDs or historical verdicts
prospective_confirmation_gate: predictions are committed before consequence values are revealed
at least four exact new invocations
at least two eligible source mechanisms
at least two risk predictions and two safe/control predictions when available

success_levels.MECHANISM_TAXONOMY: five-level localization and causal intervention only
success_levels.SUPPORTED_PROPERTY: frozen predictor succeeds on prospective confirmation
